title: Classic Quebecois Poutine Beef Casserole
description: A hearty casserole featuring layers of beef, cheese curds, and crispy fries, inspired by the popular Canadian dish.
instructions: 2. Cook the Canadian fries according to package instructions or until crispy.
3. In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
4. Add the umami-rich beef broth and bring to a simmer.
5. Stir in the zesty ketchup and cook for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
6. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked fries, beef mixture, and poutine cheese curds.
7. Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
8. Top with additional cheese curds and crispy bacon bits (if using).
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
